title: Geometry - Lesson 7 Practice: 45-45-90 Triangles
description: Practice finding missing side lengths in 45-45-90 triangles using the x:x:x sqrt(2) relationship.

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a leg of 6 units. What is the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: In a 45-45-90 triangle, hypotenuse = leg x sqrt(2). With leg 6, the hypotenuse is 6sqrt(2).

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a hypotenuse of 8sqrt(2) cm. What is the length of each leg?
questions.explanation: Divide the hypotenuse by sqrt(2): 8sqrt(2)/sqrt(2) = 8. Each leg is 8 cm.

questions.question: Which side ratio matches every 45-45-90 triangle?
questions.explanation: A 45-45-90 triangle is an isosceles right triangle, so the legs are equal and the hypotenuse is leg x sqrt(2).

questions.question: In a 45-45-90 triangle, the two legs are congruent.
questions.explanation: The two acute angles are equal, so the sides opposite them are equal. The triangle is isosceles.

questions.question: If the hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle is known, multiply it by sqrt(2) to find a leg.
questions.explanation: A leg is shorter than the hypotenuse, so divide the hypotenuse by sqrt(2) to find a leg.

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has one leg of 9. The other leg is ___.
questions.explanation: The legs of a 45-45-90 triangle are equal, so the other leg is also 9.

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a hypotenuse of 14sqrt(2). Each leg is ___.
questions.explanation: Divide 14sqrt(2) by sqrt(2). The result is 14.

questions.question: Explain how to decide whether to multiply or divide by sqrt(2) in a 45-45-90 triangle.
questions.correctAnswer: Multiply a leg by sqrt(2) to find the hypotenuse. Divide the hypotenuse by sqrt(2) to find a leg because the hypotenuse is the longest side.
questions.explanation: The direction matters. Moving from a leg to the longer hypotenuse uses multiplication, while moving from the hypotenuse to a shorter leg uses division.
